lines: Atul Hiralal Shah, Investor Selling Shareholder, may sell up to 12,600 shares for up to ₹1.70 crore, if all offered shares are sold.
Proceeds are in hand since 11 Mar 2026 (8 months ago); the trigger, shares unlocked on 9 Sep 2026, is recent at 66 days ago.
Retained holding is an estimate of ₹3.97 crore at offer price; up to ₹1.26 crore gain is before offer expenses and taxes.
Family link: Bakul Hiralal Shah shares the surname and middle name. Holdings found in one section only, so confidence is medium.
